title: Thai Carrot Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired stir fry with carrots, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers or snap peas

ingredients.name: stir
ingredients.notes: vegetable oil or oil of choice

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the juicy vegetables and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until they begin to soften.
Add the stir-fry sauce (such as soy sauce, hoisin sauce, or tamarind paste) and fry for 1-2 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot.
Optional: top with chopped peanuts or cashews for added crunch.
